profile.note: Research directions, method preferences, writing style, and experimental habits

sections.title: Source and Coverage
sections.content: The profile records its Scholar export, publication records, local writing samples, generation time, and missing inputs.

sections.title: Research Identity
sections.content: The main threads are trustworthy AI, LLM safety, and verifiable evaluation, with failure observations converted into controlled, falsifiable questions.

sections.title: Research Lineage
sections.content: The trajectory extends from task modeling and robust evaluation to safety interventions, representation mechanisms, and evidence contracts.

sections.title: Writing Style
sections.content: Abstracts close the loop from problem and gap to method and evidence; observations, explanations, and scope are kept separate.

sections.title: Experiment Templates
sections.content: Run low-cost falsification tests first, freeze data and randomness, and make every result recomputable from saved operands.

sections.title: Workflow Preferences
sections.content: Every reported number links to its result path, calculation, and command; major research decisions retain approval records.

sections.title: Publication Records
sections.content: Publication records remain searchable; self-citation is limited and structure is calibrated using the author's closest venue-matched paper.

literature.note: Verified evidence organized as Problem → Approaches → Evaluation → Gaps

sections.title: Problem
sections.content: Define the sample task as multi-objective coordination: task quality, robustness, and compute cannot be hidden by one average score.

sections.title: Approaches
sections.content: Organize prior work by data strategy, training objective, optimization method, and deployment constraint instead of paper-by-paper listing.

sections.title: Evaluation
sections.content: Separate automatic metrics, human judgments, interactive success, online outcomes, and compute, then verify whether comparisons are fair.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.content: Key gaps concern reward-conflict detection, judge validity, public reproducibility, and matched quality–cost comparisons.

ideas.note: A selected direction grounded in verified gaps, with falsifiers and deployment risks retained

sections.title: Literature Landscape
sections.content: The sample field contains several method families; its central issues are objective conflict, judge validity, and cost matching.

sections.title: Ranked Decision Slate
sections.content: Candidate I1 is selected; the remaining candidates cover algorithmic, theoretical, and evaluation paths.

sections.title: Candidate Cards
sections.content: Each card states the problem, mechanism, expected evidence, failure condition, and difference from recent work.

sections.title: Human Selection
sections.content: Only after the researcher confirms I1 does the system pass it to experiment planning; the demo is not tied to a real project name.

expplan.note: Claims determine artifacts, thresholds, controls, and evidence boundaries before execution

sections.title: Target Conference and Reference Paper
sections.content: Lock the venue first, then map concrete reference-paper sections and paragraph functions to the target paper. Structure is reused, not content.

sections.title: Projected Paper
sections.content: Extract representative Introduction and Experiments mappings from the complete plan and bind them to the option-order study's own evidence.

projected-paper.note: Titles, paragraphs, artifacts, implementation, and decision rules are planned together

sections.title: Projected Title and Abstract
sections.content: The working title, abstract logic, and evidence boundary use a generic example.

sections.title: Projected Paper Structure and Evidence Shells
sections.content: Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Method, Experiments, Analysis, and Conclusion are planned with paragraph-level artifact bindings.

runplan.note: Paper artifacts are decomposed into dependency-ordered goals with explicit outputs

sections.title: Execution Estimate
sections.content: Every goal declares its budget, dependencies, estimated time, and stopping condition before execution.

sections.title: Implementation Sources
sections.content: Every result records raw logs, the executed command, calculation rule, and verification status.

sections.title: Parts and Goals
sections.content: Inspect each goal's part, state, actual output, and completion criterion.

sections.title: Post-baseline Idea Checkpoint
sections.content: After baseline reproduction, separate implementation defects from verified scientific anomalies and offer re-ideation only when a new evidence-backed premise exists.

results.note: Every paper evidence unit is verified and retains row- or cell-level provenance

sections.title: Artifact Completion
sections.content: Each figure and table records whether results exist, verification passed, and which goal produced it.

sections.title: Paper Tables and Figures
sections.content: Exact values remain distinct from approximate reconstructions, qualitative cases, and missing results.

sections.title: Acquisition Process
sections.content: Each table cell links to its acquisition contract, result locator, command, and verification time.

paper-studio.note: Prose, figures, LaTeX, and PDF stay synchronized

sections.title: Paragraph Writing and Approval
sections.content: Each paragraph is generated from its plan and written to LaTeX only after approval.

sections.title: Figure Generation and Editing
sections.content: Figure prompts, data, captions, placement, and compiled output remain linked.

sections.title: Data and Typesetting
sections.content: All table values come from verified evidence and can be traced to their acquisition process.
